answer: Anchor every agent identity to a locked stake that grows with honest work: a new agent may whisper into the market, but it cannot vote or claim rewards until its stake has seasoned through verified transactions. A sybil farmer who splits one stake across a thousand puppet identities dilutes each one below the threshold, while creating fresh, fully staked identities costs real timber: capital locked and slashable on fraud. Forging many voices thus costs more than the influence it buys, so honest agents stay cheaper than fake ones.
